verdict.rationale: Aider is a terminal-based coding agent, so IDE integration is a fair question for it, but the evidence shows no JetBrains plugin, no interactive diff viewer inside the IDE, and no way to share a selected code range as context from the IDE. Its watch-files mode, where you leave AI comments in any editor, is only an adjacent editor-agnostic workaround and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
